location.site_description: About 374.89 acres generally at the northwest corner of I-435 and US-169, with northern boundary of N.W. 128th Street; Golden Plains Technology Park spans Platte and Clay counties.

status_as_of_cutoff: partial live. Meta's August 20, 2025 company announcement, updated November 14, 2025, states that the Kansas City Data Center is operational and serving traffic. Official Kansas City records tie Velvet Tech Services, LLC to Zone 3 of Golden Plains Technology Park, including the 2021 preliminary plat and 2022 water/wastewater agreements, and Missouri DNR issued a de minimis construction air permit for Velvet Tech Services LLC-Kansas City on April 9, 2024. No primary source located in this refresh states campus MW capacity or confirms full buildout.

actions.evidence_note: Official city record establishes the Golden Plains Zone 3 location later associated with Velvet Tech Services.

actions.result_status: Passed committee substitute for Ordinance No. 211119 authorizing Water Services agreements with Velvet Tech Services, LLC for development of Zone 3 of Golden Plains Technology Park.
